title: Polypiler spec family 'recovery'
description: The body under 'spec' of a document in spec/recovery/: one recovery rule of the block O0170-O0199 that turns lifted machine code back into readable structure (PRD §4.1, §23.2). Rules the schema cannot state: layout, id-in-block, speculation-matches-mode, proven-needs-obligation, deunroll-needs-repetitions, effects-preserved, switch-matches (PLY0046).

optimization.description: The optimization ID; equals the file name.

before.description: IR text of the canonical input.

after.description: IR text of the recovered form.

proofMode.description: proven: fires only with every obligation discharged; speculative-guarded: fires behind a run-time guard and keeps the original form as fallback. There is no value for an unguarded guess.

proofObligations.description: The obligations to discharge before the rule fires, shaped as in spec/recognition/; at least one when proofMode is proven.

speculation.description: Present exactly when proofMode is speculative-guarded.

guard.description: The condition checked at run time.

fallback.description: The original form, kept for when the guard fails.

negativeCases.description: Inputs the rule must leave alone, and why.

minRepetitions.description: The fewest repetitions the rule folds; stated exactly for technique de-unroll.
